description: This file defines the SimpleConsistentRingProvider class, which aids in constructing a consistent hash ring by maintaining a reference to the next silo in the ring within an Orleans cluster environment. It manages successor determination based on silo addresses and cluster membership snapshots.

classes.name: SimpleConsistentRingProvider
classes.description: Maintains and provides the successor silo in a consistent hash ring for Orleans silos, facilitating ring navigation and stability amidst cluster changes.

methods.name: SimpleConsistentRingProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with local silo details and cluster membership service, and determining the initial successor.

methods.name: Successor
methods.description: Property that retrieves the current successor silo in the ring, recalculating if the cluster snapshot has changed.

methods.name: FindSuccessor
methods.description: Identifies the next silo in the consistent hash ring based on the current cluster snapshot, considering hash codes and silo statuses.
